description: This Java class 'DittoHeadersSizeChecker' is responsible for validating the size of 'DittoHeaders' objects to ensure they are within specified limits, including total size and number of authorization subjects. It throws specific exceptions when size constraints are exceeded.

classes.name: DittoHeadersSizeChecker
classes.description: Immutable class that checks whether Ditto headers are within size and authorization subject count limits.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DittoHeadersSizeChecker with specified max size and auth subjects.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Validates the given DittoHeaders instance for size constraints and authorization context limitations, throwing exceptions if limits are exceeded.
